snippet.title: TI-99/4A Bio Meteor gameplay
snippet.description:
This is the gameplay of my second game I made for TI-99/4A. It is written in Extended Basic 256 and then compiled in E/A 5  option to make it faster.
The name is Bio Meteor. 
Your mission is to defend the Martian colony from the invasion of a living meteor. You can collect bonus for extra weapons and speed. Sometimes when you destroy the meteor tendrils an aggressive creature called "bioid" can spawn and it will try to kill you.

You can download the game in bin format for FinalGrom here (32Kb RAM expansion required):
https://www.ti99iuc.it/web/index.php?pageid=database_cerca&archivioid=990
